description: Runs a syntax check with the Swift compiler for a selected Swift source file.
name: swift-syntax-check
systemInstruction:
Run Swift syntax parsing only. Do not emit an executable.

Create and execute the following shell script with `skill_execute`, passing it as `content`. Replace `{{source_file}}` with the selected Swift file and optionally provide `{{swift_args}}` for SDK, target, package, or framework flags.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
SOURCE_FILE="{{source_file}}"
SWIFT_ARGS="{{swift_args}}"
[ -n "$SOURCE_FILE" ] && [ "$SOURCE_FILE" != "{{source_file}}" ] || { echo "Missing source_file" >&2; exit 1; }
if [ "$SWIFT_ARGS" = "{{swift_args}}" ]; then SWIFT_ARGS=""; fi

swiftc -parse $SWIFT_ARGS "$SOURCE_FILE"
```

Return Swift compiler diagnostics.
